verdict.rationale: Fern's docs reference a Web Analytics tab, and changelog entries describe reader feedback, search queries, unanswered Ask Fern questions, and analytics as data that Fern Agent automations can review and act on. Reader activity is also exposed through Fern's MCP server, and llms.txt traffic is broken down by LLM provider. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of page-view metrics and of the analytics dashboard itself (the three data types are mostly implied through automation and MCP mentions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
